meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩 AI 记忆文档，节省输入额度并保留可读备份。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 长期记忆越来越长、输入开销让你心疼。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI memory files to lower input costs while keeping readable backups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long AI memory files keep growing and each prompt costs more.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能把 CLAUDE.md 或待办清单等记忆文件压缩成“原始人格式”短句，覆盖原文件，并把可读备份存入系统数据目录；代码、路径、命令等原样保留。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-compress <文件路径>”，或直接要求压缩记忆文件时触发。只压缩自然语言文件，不碰代码文件。

say.note: 原文件被覆盖，备份存到系统目录。

say.text: 把 todo.md 压缩成 caveman 格式。
say.note: 需指定文件路径，Claude 才能执行。

say.text: 压缩我的偏好文件，但别动里面的代码块。
say.note: 代码块原样保留，只压缩正文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses memory files like CLAUDE.md or to-do lists into caveman-style short phrases, overwrites the original, and stores a readable backup in the system data directory; code, paths, and commands remain unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or directly ask to compress a memory file. Only natural-language files are compressed; code files are never modified.

say_en.note: Original is overwritten; backup goes to system data directory.
Specify a file path so Claude knows what to compress.

say_en.text: Compress my preferences file but leave code blocks unchanged.
say_en.note: Code blocks stay exactly as-is; only prose is compressed.
